rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, before 1994).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 1994 as 'Coral Spire'.
rows.Bloom: Coral-pink. Classic hybrid tea bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 4b through 10a. Can be used for cut flower. Hardy. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
